methodology.browser: Fresh Chromium context per sample; cache disabled; service workers blocked; gzip HTTP loopback server for every variant.
methodology.order: Scenario order rotates by round; no discarded warmups; each sample starts a fresh server child process. OS/filesystem cache is shared. Cold refers to browser cache, not cold OS/disk/edge.
methodology.readiness: performance.now() at first animation frame with all three remote DOM nodes and the counter effect mounted; excludes Playwright wait overhead.
methodology.interaction: 12 programmatic context-remote button clicks per page, each followed by two animation frames and sibling DOM validation; includes frame scheduling. Not INP or real input latency.
methodology.transfer: CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength for requested Script/Stylesheet resources; gzip and HTTP 200 asserted. Includes response headers; excludes document/fonts/data. All-resource totals are separate.
methodology.build: Sum of gzip/Brotli per emitted JS/CSS file, host client and three remotes. Includes unrequested chunks; excludes server/fonts/JSON/HTML/maps.
methodology.scope: Local reproducible synthetic benchmark, not Zephyr network performance or a universal speedup. No timing pass/fail thresholds.
